_comment: INSTALL-06 — pinned third-party binary versions for the assembled Windows runtime package. Neither vendor publishes an official SHA256 for these specific archives (verified during the INSTALL-06 audit) — sha256 values below are self-established: downloaded once, sanity-checked (file version/size/content, matching the pinned version exactly), hashed, and committed here as the trusted value all future automated builds verify against. scripts/fetchWindowsRuntimeDependencies.js refuses to run against a still-placeholder value — it never treats an unverified download as trusted.

postgresql._urlNote: Resolved — landing page access is no longer blocked (confirmed working in a later session; earlier sessions got HTTP 403 from every access method tried). Real download URL below verified independently via a direct HTTP HEAD request (200, application/zip, Content-Length 343808005) before download, then verified again after: exact byte size match, genuine ZIP signature, archive layout matches pgsql/bin/*.exe exactly, and the extracted postgres.exe --version genuinely reports '18.6' (not just a trusted filename). The server sends no Content-Disposition filename — expectedFilenamePattern below is the exact name this download was verified under, not a server-confirmed one.

nssm._verifiedNote: Downloaded for real, extracted, and sanity-checked in this session: win64\nssm.exe reports FileVersion '2.24-101-g897c7ad', ProductName 'NSSM 64-bit', CompanyName 'Iain Patterson' (the real NSSM author) — matches the pinned version exactly. Not code-signed (expected/normal for NSSM releases — this checksum is the compensating control).

vcredist._why: Installer B1 — the bundled PostgreSQL binaries (initdb/pg_ctl/postgres/pg_dump/pg_restore/libpq, PE linker version 14.44) import vcruntime140.dll, vcruntime140_1.dll and msvcp140.dll. None ships with Windows or in the EDB binaries zip. installer/studix.iss runs this redistributable before firstInstall.js.
vcredist._urlNote: The landingPage permalink always serves Microsoft's latest build, so it cannot be pinned. The url below is the versioned download it redirected to (HTTP 301) on 2026-09-30. The path segment before the file name is the file's own SHA-256.
vcredist._verifiedNote: Downloaded for real on 2026-09-30 (25635768 bytes). Get-FileHash and sha256sum agreed, and both equal the hash in Microsoft's URL. Authenticode status Valid, signer CN=Microsoft Corporation, issuer Microsoft Code Signing PCA 2011. FileVersion 14.44.35211.0, ProductName 'Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 Redistributable (x64) - 14.44.35211', which matches the 14.44 toolset the PostgreSQL binaries were linked with.
